io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.whenToUse: Use this server when someone hands you a Faylee link (https://app.faylee.app/s/...) or asks about a bug recorded with Faylee. Start with open_recording on the link, then get_moment on the times that matter. It returns the screen at any moment, what the person said and clicked, the console with stacks mapped to source, and every network request in full, so you can find the cause in the code, fix it and report back with add_comment. A connection reads what the person who connected it can read.
